---SOURCE EXCERPT---

interests of the company, and shall exercise the degree of care, diligence and skill that a reasonably
prudent person would exercise in comparable circumstances.

A director shall act in good faith and in the best interests of the company, and shall exercise the degree of care, diligence and skill that a reasonably prudent person would exercise in comparable circumstances.

[company_commercial] Based on 52. A director who is interested in a transaction or proposed transaction with the company shall, what does the provision establish?

---SOURCE EXCERPT---
52. A director who is interested in a transaction or proposed transaction with the company shall
disclose the nature and extent of that interest to the board as soon as practicable after the director
becomes aware of the facts that give rise to the interest.

According to the source text (52. A director who is interested in a transaction or proposed transaction with the company shall): 52. A director who is interested in a transaction or proposed transaction with the company shall disclose the nature and extent of that interest to the board as soon as practicable after the director becomes aware of the facts that give rise to the interest.
